author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Add independent policy watchdog and fresh-epoch restart behavior
details: Completed policy ticks alone renew a bounded lease. Independent supervisor and scheduler guard latch unavailable, clip pulses to the admitted lease and request off on expiry. Add SIGTERM cleanup, subprocess restart/failure tests and an uninstalled simulated-output service example. No GPIO or real Pi access; frozen-output limitations remain.
validation: 83 edge cases: Linux 83 passed; Windows 82 passed with POSIX SIGTERM skipped. 59 shared/dashboard tests passed on Linux; checked publishing repeats shared/repository/changelog/whitespace validation. Synthetic demo ends off/unarmed at startup, faulted/off after stalled feeds, with no credentials or GPIO.
